description: FX symbols: the list of currencies with daily European Central Bank reference rates (about 30), each with its ISO 4217 code and English name, plus how many pairs they make. Use to check which currencies /fx and /fx/all can convert before calling them, or to fill a currency picker. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

only.description: Optional: comma-separated top-level result keys to keep, for a smaller answer (for example only=price,symbol); unknown keys are ignored and an empty match returns the full result

name: fx_symbols
title: FX symbols, currency list
